editionLabel: Helvetiq English rules, undated two-page sheet with Coiledspring Games UK importer
firstPlayerRule: Whoever visited a museum most recently starts the first raid.
houseFallback: If the visit is tied or nobody has visited a museum, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: Later raids start with the player holding the Guard Dog figure; the museum criterion selects only the opening player.
The Alibi comparison breaks a final-score tie. It does not decide who starts.
